do_more: Use direct, profound verbatim book quotes as titles instead of modern summaries or explanations
Focus on practical, actionable psychological advice and inner mental control (e.g., managing attention, turning over a new leaf)
Keep titles concise and provocative without relying on emojis or hashtags in the title text
Lean into philosophical frameworks that speak directly to the viewer's daily self-improvement and mental clarity
avoid: Avoid generic 'in 60 seconds' or book review formats which heavily underperform
Avoid long, descriptive narrative hook titles about historical figures or plot summaries
Avoid cluttering titles with emojis, numbers like '2,400 Years', and platform tags like #shorts
title_style: Winning titles frame profound philosophical truths as direct commands or stark psychological realizations using the book's exact verbatim words rather than modern commentary.
next_tests: Test 5 new shorts using pure, hard-hitting 1-sentence book quotes as titles with zero emojis
Compare the performance of actionable self-improvement quotes against abstract philosophical quotes
Test removing all hashtags and numbers from current title templates to check impact on algorithmic reach
